combo_label: Around the House × At the Funfair × Pirates & the High Seas

entries.clue: Chairs on chains that fly outward as the ride picks up speed
Taps, a plughole, and a growing heap of washing-up
Iron-bound box of loot, the one fifteen men sat on, yo ho ho
Gold Spanish coin that clinks satisfyingly in a captain's hoard
Fish a floating yellow toy from the pool with a pole — a winner every time
Kitchen unit with drawers below and plates proudly displayed above
Short curved sword, the boarding party's sidearm of choice
Cool space below the ground floor, traditional keeper of wine
Stevenson's one-legged sea cook, sharing his name with a precious metal
Little electric cars with rubber skirts, steered straight at your mates
Mop the deck — or the lowly deckhand ordered to do it
